from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545201/attempts/077c639e3ede471faa305f8b7291dc1f/system/state/workspace/programs')

source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0)
    target = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == target]
    r0 = min(r for r, _ in points)
    c0 = min(c for _, c in points)
    shape = [(r - r0, c - c0) for r, c in points]
    height = max(dr for dr, _ in shape) + 1
    width = max(dc for _, dc in shape) + 1
    for r in range(len(grid) - height + 1):
        for c in range(len(grid[0]) - width + 1):
            if all(grid[r + dr][c + dc] == 0 for dr, dc in shape):
                for dr, dc in shape:
                    out[r + dr][c + dc] = target
    return out
'''
path=base/'task-31444cce.py'
